hazards.evidence: A white bath mat is hanging over the edge of the tub and touching the floor, which could slip or be tripped over.
The tub has a high step-over and no transfer bench or other aid to assist with getting in and out safely.
Although a shower seat is present, the handheld shower head is mounted high and may not be easily reachable or usable without assistance.
A dog is lying in the bathtub, which is an unexpected obstacle and could cause a fall if the person attempts to use the tub without noticing.
